description: Standardized Acceptance Fixtures for Internal Structure Shift (ISS) Module

iss_01_bearish_basic_end_to_end.description: Genuine end-to-end Bearish main structure. MSM execution confirms Main L2 (CH at Bar 4, price 1.2000) and identifies Main L3 (CL at Bar 7, price 1.1400) at Bar 9. Five internal upward points strictly inside boundary and completion close inside. Creates RBS zone on CH2 (Bar 14) and buying A+ zone on CL2 (Bar 16).

iss_02_bullish_basic_end_to_end.description: Genuine end-to-end Bullish main structure. MSM execution confirms Main L2 (CL at Bar 4, price 1.1000) and identifies Main L3 (CH at Bar 7, price 1.1600) at Bar 9. Five internal downward points strictly inside boundary and completion close inside. Creates SBR zone on CL2 (Bar 14) and selling A+ zone on CH2 (Bar 16).

iss_03_boundary_equality.description: Marked internal point 5 body-edge price exactly equals captured boundary price (1.2000). Verified that boundary equality satisfies the inclusive range condition.

iss_04_wick_excursion_allowed.description: Candle wicks pierce beyond the frozen range boundaries (low 1.1350 < 1.1400 and high 1.2060 > 1.2000) while all marked body edges remain strictly inside. Confirms ISS per Section 5.

iss_05_out_of_bounds_marked_point_reject.description: Marked internal point 3 body edge (1.2020) breaches frozen upper boundary (1.2000). Candidate permanently rejected, internal markings removed, zero zones created.

expected_outcome.rejection_reason: Marked level CH2 price 1.2020 exceeds upper boundary 1.2000

iss_06_outside_range_completion_tracking.description: All 5 marked points valid inside [1.1400, 1.2000], but completion candle closes at 1.1350 outside boundary. ISS not confirmed, no zones created, internal markings retained only for tracking.

iss_07_no_revival_under_same_main_level_.description: Subsequent internal price action following an outside-range completion attempt cannot revive ISS eligibility under the same main level 3.

iss_08_fresh_search_on_new_main_level_3.description: Following prior candidate rejection, a new valid main level 3 is identified. A fresh candidate opens with new captured boundaries and succeeds.

iss_09_main_continuation_cancellation.description: Main continuation closing break (1.1320 < 1.1400) occurs before ISS completes. Unfinished ISS candidate cancelled without zones.

iss_10_main_choch_cancellation.description: Main CHOCH confirms (two consecutive closes > 1.2000) while internal candidate is unfinished. Active ISS candidate cancelled; confirmed history retained.

iss_11_retained_history_preservation.description: Confirmed ISS zones and labels remain in history after later main continuation break.

iss_12_zone_provenance_and_geometry.description: Zone provenance check: zones derived strictly from internal points 3 and 4, never from main level 3 or internal point 5.

iss_13_zero_width_zones.description: Original candle has zero relevant top wick (high == UB == 1.1750). RBS zone retains thickness 0 ([1.1750, 1.1750]), single price line.

iss_14_first_internal_pullback_timing_re.description: Internal pullback candles must occur strictly after the second candle of the main pullback (chronological position > 9).

iss_15_prefix_consistency_and_ids.description: Sequential prefix evaluations with arbitrary IDs verify idempotent deterministic point identification.
